definition: Dr.Fill is a computer program that solves American-style crossword puzzles.
details: It was developed by Matt Ginsberg, who described it in the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research. Ginsberg claims in that article that Dr.Fill is among the top fifty crossword solvers in the world.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. That is Dr.Fill — a small key that opens a big door.
